quests.title: Firing Day
quests.summary: Help the fireman at Gladstone fire a bottle oven for the museum, the old way.

steps.text: Get saggars from the saggar maker's bottom knocker at Middleport Pottery.
Get a load of coal from Boatman Alf on the canal towpath.
Fetch wad clay from the clay cellar at Spode Works.
Take it all back to the fireman in the Gladstone yard and fire the oven.

quests.reward: A Kiln Brick charm, a Saggit of your own and standing in England.

quests.title: The Wallaby of the Roaches
quests.summary: Follow the sightings and find the last wallaby of the Roaches.

steps.text: Ask the walker by the Hanging Stone.
Ask the ranger at Doxey Pool, up on the Roaches.
Ask at the boathouse on Rudyard Lake.
Catch the wallaby at Roach End, at dawn or dusk.
Tell the Wallaby Watcher by Rockhall Cottage.

quests.reward: A Staffordshire Knot, Kendal Mint Cake and standing in England.

quests.title: The Oatcake Round
quests.summary: Deliver three oatcakes round Stoke while they're still warm.

steps.text: Deliver an oatcake to the attendant at the Potteries Museum.
Deliver an oatcake to the landlord of the Leopard Inn.
Deliver an oatcake to the City fan by the Potters' Ground.
Go back to the Oatcake Lady at the hatch.

quests.reward: Oatcakes, oatmeal and the recipe to make your own.

quests.title: The Staffordshire Hoard
quests.summary: Learn the story of the largest Anglo-Saxon gold hoard ever found.

steps.text: Look at the Hoard cases with the Gallery Guide.
Find the detectorist in the fields below the Roaches.
Answer the curator's question at the Potteries Museum.

quests.reward: A Hoard Garnet charm and standing in England.
